payload.title: OTel export + FRICK_OTEL_* config parsing
payload.description: Compose sets FRICK_OTEL_ENABLED + ops/local/otel-collector.yaml exists, but config.rs doesn't parse FRICK_OTEL_* and there is no OTLP exporter. Add the config surface + a tracing-opentelemetry OTLP layer wired in main.rs/boot, behind FRICK_OTEL_ENABLED. Live export needs a collector; config + layer init are unit-testable.
